metrics.label: Total Pixels
metrics.description: Pixels evaluated (whole image, or the AOI subset when supplied).

metrics.label: Canopy Pixels
metrics.description: Pixels isolated as active vegetation canopy.

metrics.label: Canopy Coverage
metrics.description: Canopy pixels as a percentage of the evaluated area.

metrics.label: Mean VARI
metrics.description: Average Visible Atmospherically Resistant Index over canopy pixels (canopy vigour).

metrics.label: Mean Red
metrics.description: Mean red reflectance of canopy pixels (0–1).

metrics.label: Mean Green
metrics.description: Mean green reflectance of canopy pixels (0–1).

metrics.label: Mean Blue
metrics.description: Mean blue reflectance of canopy pixels (0–1).

metrics.label: Red Std Dev
metrics.description: Standard deviation of red reflectance over canopy pixels.

metrics.label: Green Std Dev
metrics.description: Standard deviation of green reflectance over canopy pixels.

metrics.label: Blue Std Dev
metrics.description: Standard deviation of blue reflectance over canopy pixels.

metrics.label: Mean Hue
metrics.description: Average HSL hue angle of canopy pixels.

metrics.label: Mean Saturation
metrics.description: Average HSL saturation of canopy pixels (0–1).

metrics.label: Vigorous Canopy
metrics.description: Share of canopy pixels in the vigorous class (VARI at or above the vigorous threshold).

metrics.label: Moderate Stress Canopy
metrics.description: Share of canopy pixels in the moderate stress class.

metrics.label: Severe Stress Canopy
metrics.description: Share of canopy pixels in the severe stress class.

metrics.label: Dominant Condition
metrics.description: Condition class holding the largest share of canopy: vigorous, moderate_stress, severe_stress or none.

metrics.label: Yellowing (Chlorosis)
metrics.description: Share of canopy pixels inside the chlorosis hue window with sufficient saturation.

metrics.label: Browning (Necrosis)
metrics.description: Share of canopy pixels with high RBVI and red dominance (necrotic/dry foliage).

metrics.label: Zonation Cells
metrics.description: Number of cells in the condition zonation artifact.

metrics.label: Plots Analysed
metrics.description: Number of plots evaluated from the plots parameter.

metrics.label: Healthiest Plot
metrics.description: Plot with the highest mean VARI.

metrics.label: Most Stressed Plot
metrics.description: Plot with the lowest mean VARI.
